patchlogs.name: Gara Prime: Hotfix 30.3.5
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed ability to enter a Dojo via Railjack without owning a Clan Key.

patchlogs.name: The Jovian Concord: Update 25.1.0
patchlogs.changes: Upon selecting to craft a Clan Key, the Foundry will automatically now show the ‘Clan Key’ crafting screen instead of making you search for it.

patchlogs.name: Octavia's Anthem: Update 20
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed Clan Key Blueprints remaining in the Foundry after leaving a Clan.

patchlogs.name: Specters of the Rail: Hotfix 12
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed node displaying as "Clan Key" instead of actual Clan name when selecting Dojo from the Star Chart. This also fixes the Clan screen/nodes/UI components overlapping on top of the Clan Management screen.
